mapper.insert: insert into emp(username, name, gender, phone, job, salary, image, entry_date, dept_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username},#{name},#{gender},#{phone},#{job},#{salary},#{image},#{entry_date},#{dept_id},#{create_time},#{update_time})
mapper.select: select count(*) from tlias.emp e left join tlias.dept d on e.dept_id = d.id

select e.id, e.username, e.name, e.gender, e.phone, e.job, e.salary, e.image, e.entry_date, e.dept_id, e.create_time, e.update_time, d.name as dept_name from tlias.emp e left join tlias.dept d on e.dept_id = d.id
